race.comment: NEAP TIDE (1) looks well placed to improve after finishing fifth in a Class 3 at Ascot, beaten just over three lengths, and he now comes back to easier company with William Pike returning to a horse he has won on twice. Looks ready to peak at this stage of the campaign and he can land the knockout blow. CAPABLE ANGEL (4) is the immediate danger after going under by just under a length to QUEEN NARDI at this track as the short odds-on favourite, and her record at this venue keeps her right in the contest. QUEEN NARDI (6) has the key recent result, having beaten CAPABLE ANGEL at this track last start, and she brings consistent campaign form plus a 3kg claim. Carries less weight than she did last start and can repeat the dose. OBSCENTINO (5) comes back from Saturday grade and finds the right race to improve. POINT OF LUCK (11) can't be left out of calculations.
